source: Harvard Ascending Arousal Network Atlas v2.0 (Edlow BL, Kinney HC, 2023; Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.zw3r228d2)
notes: Harvard Ascending Arousal Network Atlas Version 2.0 covers 16 arousal and neuromodulatory nodes in the brainstem.
Provides bilateral subdivision for LC, LDTg, mRt, PBC, PnO, and PTg, plus midline raphe and tegmental nuclei.
Remapped to clean sequential uint8 indices (1..16) for seamless NiiVue colormap display while preserving source_code.
